title: TRUCK SKEE-BALL
prompt: Create an original finished TRANSPARENT title logo for a 1998–2002 PS1/PS2 mascot arcade sports game. Required reference style: CHUNKY WOBBLY UNEVEN custom hand-lettering, strong sculpted angular bevels painted in THREE broad color planes, thick blue-black outline plus ivory keyline, low-poly faceted toy semi trucks with enormous wheels. Invent a distinct composition. NO realistic materials, no photographic detail, no shiny modern mobile logo, no fine noise. Crisp HD illustration, not pixel art. No panel/background scene, genuine alpha, ample clear margins. All exact words legible and unobscured. EXACT title: "TRUCK SKEE-BALL". Composition: Purple and tangerine jaunty sculptural letters sweeping up a cartoon wooden ramp, three circular scoring holes BEHIND the title on right, small faceted semi jumping like a skee ball at upper LEFT. No extra score text.
